_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 10 가정법의 단원 연습에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 기본 10과 가정법 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: 1  [It were / Were it] windy, I would fly a kite.
2  [If / Had] I enough money, I would buy that bag.
3  [But / Without] his advice, she could not have finished the work.
4  [Were / Had] it not been for the map, we couldn’t have found the way.
5  Were I not busy, I [would join / would have joined] the club.
6  It’s time you [start / started] your homework.
questions.answer: 1 Were it  2 If  3 Without  4 Had  5 would join  6 started

questions.point_label: But for = if it were not for / if it had not been for
questions.prompt: 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: 1  [[But for the bus]], we would not get to school on time.  ① If it were not for the bus  ② If it had not been for the bus
2  [[But for her help]], I would have failed the test.  ① If it were not for her help  ② If it had not been for her help
3  [[Without water]], we could not live even a day.  ① If it were not for water  ② If it had not been for water
4  [[But for the map]], I could not have found the museum.  ① Were it not for the map  ② Had it not been for the map

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
body: 날씨가 시원하다면, 야외에서 점심을 먹을 텐데. (be, cool, it)
→ ________________, I would have lunch outside.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
body: 난로가 없다면, 겨울에 우리 교실은 무척 추울 텐데. (will, be, without)
→ ________ the heater, our classroom ________ very cold in winter.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
body: 물이 없다면, 나는 하루도 살 수 없을 텐데. (be, for, not, it)
→ ________________ water, I couldn’t live even a day.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
body: 우리가 짐을 쌀 시간이야. 내일 떠나잖아. (time, it’s, pack, we)
→ ________________ our bags. We leave tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸을 완성하세요.
body: 그 사진이 없었다면, 경찰은 그를 찾지 못했을 텐데. (not, be, for, it)
→ ________________ the photo, the police might not have found him.

questions.prompt: 괄호 안의 말을 참고하여 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: My dad treats me as if I ______ a baby. (In fact, I’m not a baby.)

questions.prompt: 괄호 안의 말을 참고하여 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: She talked as if she ______ the movie. (In fact, she wasn’t watching the movie.)

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: If I ______ a bird, I would fly to you.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: If she ______ the bus, she wouldn’t have been late.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: I wish I ______ taller. Then I could reach the top shelf.
